chronology: zero-call payload schema repair / V1R1 reseal
blind baseline + blind Blackhole candidate sealing
oracle opened only after both candidate sets were sealed

comparison.error_rate_reduction_formula: 1 - (Blackhole error / Baseline error), where error = 1 - LQA and Baseline error > 0

configuration.checkpoint_isolation: native Codex CLI fork; query forks are discarded and never resumed

A_semantic_correctness.description: All six successful candidates have semantic false positives and/or false negatives; this is measured by the deterministic assertion comparison, not by a tuning judgment.

B_schema_or_output.description: Baseline has missing query objects at checkpoints; Blackhole is schema-valid in all three scored worlds.

C_source_or_provenance.description: All six candidates remain source-integrity valid; provenance exactness and recall are reported separately as evaluator evidence.

D_operational_reliability.description: Baseline had three operational retries across the worlds; Blackhole had none. Failed-attempt runtime was not estimated.

no_tuning_statement: This report is deterministic verification, scoring, and descriptive analysis only. No runtime, prompt, candidate, benchmark case, response contract, query bundle, expected output, or evaluator was modified after observing results; no model/provider calls were made during scoring.

scorer.formula: per-query TP / (TP + FP + FN), with LQA-0M as the arithmetic mean over all fixed query scores at checkpoints

semantic_repair_record.repair_statement: V1R1 changes only the public payload container from string to {text: string} and recomputes dependent source hashes. Event text and all expected semantic assertions are unchanged.
